RE-SCOPED 2026-10-03 BY USER RULING. On 2026-10-03 the user ruled REVISE on this record -- not ABANDONED, and not revived as filed. The ruling is carried as a checked Phase 0 box in specs/ROADMAP.md ("RULED 2026-10-03 by the user: REVISE"), and the ROADMAP Fronts table has moved this task off the Parked row onto the gluing route. The authoritative scope input is Section B and the section "The 711 tension" of specs/721_decidability_programme_review_l_and_lplus/followup-scope-spec.md, whose anchors are re-verified in that file's Section 0 rows 10-11. Everything below the ORIGINAL SCOPE marker is superseded and must not be read as current.

WHAT THIS TASK NOW NAMES. The universal-summary substrate for the stab (box-dot) fibre check on the seam-gluing route to decidability of full L-plus. The seam-gluing route presents a possible world as a backward ray glued to a forward ray at a seam, and presents the stab fibre as a path space (Probe718.seamFibreEquiv, plusStab_iff_rays, seamOmegaEquiv, plusStab_iff_omega, all under [F.IsRegular], in specs/evidence/seam-gluing-ray-product/stab-fibre-is-ray-product.lean). Checking stab over that path space requires a summary device that is UNIVERSAL -- quantifying over all paths -- and therefore complementation-shaped. This task is the record of that substrate: WHICH device, and what it costs to build.

THE DEVICE IS TO BE SELECTED BY PROBE E3, NOT ASSUMED. Four devices are live candidates and none has been selected by any probe. This task asserts nothing about which is right:
(a) Safra/Piterman omega-automata determinization (Safra, FOCS 1988; Piterman's improvement) with the Rabin or parity acceptance infrastructure it rests on -- the device this task originally named;
(b) Safraless decision procedures (Kupferman and Vardi, "Safraless decision procedures", FOCS 2005; recorded as a WANTED source at ~/Projects/Literature/SOURCES.md section "D8. omega-automata determinization -- the canonical and tight-bound sources", whose Priority note also records that NO formalization of Safra or Piterman determinization exists in ANY proof assistant, so there is no prior art to lean on for a mechanization either way);
(c) the MSO-over-<Z,<>-plus-Buechi route of Hodkinson, Wolter and Zakharyaschev, "Decidable fragments of first-order temporal logics", APAL 106 (2000) -- their route (1), which expresses "a quasimodel satisfying phi exists" as a monadic second-order sentence over the flow and discharges it by Buechi/Rabin, covers <Z,<>, is non-elementary, and NEEDS NO SAFRA CONSTRUCTION (see .claude/context/project/logic/domain/ztime-no-finite-carrier-fmp.md section 8, "The published counterpart");
(d) a Ramsey-coloured summary as in finding F4 -- the re-scoped statement of task 709 (finite width implies eventually periodic, via infinite Ramsey for pairs over the colours (E, lab, fwdLive, bwdLive)).
Selection is experiment E3 in the scope spec's "Ranking ratification" section: a device-selection probe comparing the candidate universal devices on the stab-of-eventually and stab-of-once shapes, BEFORE anything is funded. NO DEVICE MAY BE ASSERTED AS THE RIGHT ONE, AND NO COMPLEXITY BOUND MAY BE CLAIMED, FROM THIS RECORD. The CTL-star 2EXPTIME lower bound (task 713, ARGUED, not proved) is the sanity ceiling on any procedure later proposed, never an upper-bound source.

CONSUMER, RE-POINTED. The consumer of this substrate is DELIVERABLE 5 of the ray-layer/seam-gluing task (719), "THE DECIDABLE-CHECK CONNECTION", which is where a decidable stab check on the path-space presentation is to be determined. The former consumer -- the L-plus sliced finite model property record (712) -- is NO LONGER THE CONSUMER: the statement 712 was filed to prove is machine-checked FALSE (Probe710.not_sliced_complete and Probe710.not_finite_width_fmp in specs/710_sliced_class_incompleteness_characterization/probes/NoFiniteWidthModel.lean), so the old edge pointed at a result that no longer exists.

STILL BLOCKED. Blocked reason (recorded here because this record carries no blocked-reason field and this revision adds no state fields): DEVICE NOT YET SELECTED; PROBE E3 PENDING. Do not plan and do not implement this task until E3 has selected a device. Dependencies remain empty by design: nothing upstream gates device selection, only the unrun probe does.

PROHIBITION, PRESERVED. The prohibition already recorded in task 719's own description stands unchanged: NO PHASE OF TASK 719 MAY BEGIN BUILDING A DETERMINIZATION SUBSTRATE. 719 consumes this record; it does not absorb it.

WHY REVISE RATHER THAN ABANDON. The ROADMAP's former ABANDONED recommendation was RIGHT ABOUT THE ROUTE THIS TASK ORIGINALLY NAMED -- Emerson-Jutla 1988 determinization via Reynolds 2001, for the finite model property of task 712 -- which is closed along with the refuted 712. It was WRONG ABOUT THE NEED this task was filed to make visible, because that need has been re-demonstrated on a DIFFERENT question. Probe718PathQuantifier.exists_ne_stab and Probe718PathQuantifier.exists_ne_universal (specs/evidence/seam-gluing-ray-product/path-quantifier-alternation.lean) prove, on the shared two-state Bool fixture, that the existential (nondeterministic) per-path summary is True everywhere while the stab-of-eventually value is False everywhere (Probe718FiniteGraph.decide_will in specs/evidence/seam-gluing-ray-product/finite-graph-stab-summary.lean, with a self-contained twin Probe718PathQuantifier.decide_will in the path-quantifier file). So a universal, complementation-shaped summary device is NECESSARY there and a nondeterministic summary is UNSOUND -- an elementary, finite, non-automata-theoretic divergence. THE PROBES DO NOT SHOW THAT SAFRA/PITERMAN SPECIFICALLY IS THAT DEVICE. Neither prior record anticipated that the probes would answer device necessity rather than the FMP-route question this task was filed on.

REVIVAL CONDITION: MET. The condition recorded in specs/718_omega_sequence_decidability_full_lplus/.decisions.json, cycle 1 -- "Revive 711 only after R1's falsification probes 1-3 land, so determinization is funded on evidence of necessity rather than expectation" -- is now MET: those probes landed in task 718's Phases 2, 3 and 5 and are wired by scripts/check-evidence-probes.sh. The outstanding gate is device selection (E3), not evidence of necessity.

ORIGINAL SCOPE (superseded 2026-10-03; retained for provenance only). BLOCKED AND DELIBERATELY NOT SCHEDULED. This task exists to make a dependency VISIBLE, not to be worked. WHAT IT NAMED: the only known proof route to the finite model property for FULL L-plus (task 712) is the deterministic-automata route the CTL-star proofs take -- Emerson and Jutla 1988 via Reynolds 2001, which lets a deterministic Rabin linear automaton run in the background along each path; that route needs omega-automata DETERMINIZATION (Safra's construction, or Piterman's improvement) together with the Rabin or parity acceptance infrastructure it rests on. WHY BLOCKED: neither this tree nor Mathlib has any of it, and task 706's research recorded the route as OUT OF REACH (its decision D4). ITS SOLE FUNCTION was to be the named, honest blocker of the full L-plus finite model property. That function is discharged: 712's statement is refuted, so the blocker it named no longer gates anything, and this record is re-scoped as above rather than closed.
